pr_title: GameEngine: enable Codex MCP 2026 protocol mode
pr_body:
## Summary

Explicitly enables Codex 0.148.0's `mcp_2026_07_28` feature for both Build and Ask launches so the pinned adapter uses the Editor's modern MCP 2026-07-28 transport instead of Codex's legacy default. Adds regression assertions for both launch paths.
